### Problem Description
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and the proposed architectural approach.

### Legal / Regulatory Rationale
How does this feature enhance legal compliance, precedence resolution, GDPR auditing, or multi-tenant agent reliability?

### Alternative Approaches Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, API design sketches, or literature citations (e.g. NeurIPS, LegalBench) here.
